_comment: Mock ambiguous support ticket for testing whether a Choice decision changes when its options are reordered. Run: jev-xray stability examples/mock_option_order.json -q route --provider langsmith --segmenter sentence
state: My replacement arrived, but I was charged again and the tracking page still shows the old shipment. I am not sure whether this belongs with billing or delivery support. Please route this to whoever can fix both issues.

route.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

criteria.billing: Duplicate charges, invoices, refunds, and payment problems
criteria.logistics: Shipping, tracking, delivery, and replacement problems
criteria.support: General product help that is neither billing nor delivery
criteria.other: Anything not covered by the other options
